metadata.description: Skills for planning and building a feature with an AI coding agent while the engineer keeps control, split by discipline.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: The shared base every discipline installs: Tatty the guide, model and effort modes, connection and LLM setup, token metrics, and the shared rules, templates and scripts the other plugins use.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Plan, build, debug and review code with the engineer in control: familiarise, adversarial planning, task breakdown, execute, lite and quick routes, debug and git branch review. Needs core.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: The design discipline's skills: user stories from a design document. Needs core.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: The QA discipline's skills: write a bug from a plain-English description, break a feature into areas to test and work through them. Needs core.

plugins.name: production
plugins.description: Placeholder for the production discipline's skills. Needs core.
